verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an Amazon SES SMTP interface as an alternative to the SDK or API. It works with a variety of SMTP-enabled languages and software, and there is a documented guide for routing an existing email server's outgoing mail through SES, which covers the legacy-app case. Missing for 10: no evidence describing how SMTP credentials are generated (IAM is mentioned only for general access control), no SMTP endpoint, port or TLS details, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of SMTP relay use.
